card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

mechanism: A disguises missing money as banking trouble because another sister-loan conflict may split the relationship.
confusable: Unlike protecting reputation alone, the withholding must be driven by fear of one more relational rupture.
comparison: D87-b blocks bank verification to preserve a shared table; D87-a delays opening a letter to prevent repacking.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
